Resource and provenance distinctions

L=3072 Legendre sites and M=768 midpoint frequency bins are different operators and representations. The earlier L3072 Q=2 reference had4,732,419 states. The sufficient L1536 reference has1,186,563 states. The evaluated M192 model has19,299 states; its192-column array uses59,286,528 bytes, before workspaces. Mathematical modes are not physical qubits. The centered ideal comparison and conditional numerical error ledger now apply at the evaluated192-mode size. The response-jet improvement adds no bath modes or physical qubits. Arithmetic assumptions remain explicit. The capacity192-label product is unrelated to this bath mode count.

The fixed-launch response bound is not a universal diamond-norm certificate. No scalar covariance cancellation replaces operator propagation. No change of temperature or target is authorized by a failed conservative upper bound.
